title: 50 Sea Turtle
meta_description: Pet Friendly with Gulf Views - 50 Sea Turtle by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 50 Sea Turtle by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 50 Sea Turtle Drive Details: 50 Sea Turtle is a beautifully refurbished Gulf-view retreat located along a private, gated, Gulf-front street in Seagrove Beach. Offering approximately 1,900 square feet of interior living space, this inviting home comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests with three bedrooms, an open hallway bunk nook, and 2.5 baths. Hardwood floors, a vaulted living area, and Gulf views from many rooms create a relaxed coastal setting for your 30A getaway. Step outside onto the covered porch to enjoy the Gulf breeze and views, or head to the private neighborhood beach access just steps from the home. With Seaside approximately 2.5 miles away and the Timpoochee Trail nearby, 50 Sea Turtle provides a convenient location for exploring the restaurants, shops, and coastal communities of Scenic Highway 30A. This home is also pet friendly for dogs, making it easy to bring your four-legged family members along for the vacation. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Steps to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (4), Including (2) Under Carport -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Island Seating for 2 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker -Gated, Gulf-Front Street -Gulf Views -Covered Porch -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill -*Pet-Friendly With Approval *Pet friendly for an additional cost of $350 per pet (pre-tax). Please contact reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 2.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Laundry Closet -Half Bath -Covered Porch with Gulf Views Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed -Bedroom 3 (Bunk Nook): Twin/Twin Bunk* -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed -Shared Hall Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) *The bunk nook is located in the open hallway and does not have a privacy door. Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
